source: read off tests/data/report_page.png itself (1240x1754 raster, no text layer)
notes: One page: a title line, two paragraphs of seven identical lines each (cut at the right page edge), a ruled 5x4 table, then a hatched figure with its caption to its right.
The title is the page's only heading and is level 0. The paragraphs repeat one sentence, so they give no anchor that tells them apart.

Header cells read 'col 0' to 'col 3' with a space. Body cells read 'cell r,c' with no space after the comma; the wide side bearing of the '1' glyph makes 'cell 1,1' look spaced, but the comma is set tight in every other cell.
No figure placement is asserted: the only text before the figure is the second of two identical paragraphs, so an anchor cannot say which one it follows.
